data.text: I’m willing to commit to 15 tons and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, provided all five of us agree to the plan before we fish. My family taught me to protect this lake, and protecting our neighbors matters too. This must be a one-time exception: I’ll also commit to no more than six tons next month, with everyone keeping that same cap so the lake can recover. John, can you confirm both commitments?
